Youth Technology and AI Workshops

Teaching practical technology concepts to children

From August 2024 to June 2025, I taught technology and AI workshops for children aged 6 to 12 through the Habitat Foundation.

The workshops totaled more than 54 hours. Each session required turning technical ideas into exercises that younger learners could understand and try for themselves.
